note: 🔴 REQ-112 trigger T3's lever. M1–M3 are the three @Sober named: the code missing from the validator, missing from the DB CHECK, and accepted on a course END. The rest guard the design — a SIBLING set, so END_REASONS (also the course-end and voucher-end set) never moves.

mutations.what: 🔴 the code is MISSING FROM THE VALIDATOR — the status route refuses it at the door (so the screen can never send the T3 trigger)
🔴 the code is MISSING FROM THE DATABASE CHECK — the migration lists four codes, so a SCHOOL_ISSUE cancel is Postgres 23514 ⇒ a 500 on live (the 0045 incident, again)
🔴 the code is ACCEPTED ON A COURSE END — `endCourse` asks the session predicate, so Postgres refuses it on `course_packages_end_reason_chk` (a 500, not a 400)
the code is added to `END_REASONS` ITSELF instead of a sibling — the course-end and voucher-end sets silently grow, and Postgres refuses it there
the series cancel-all drops back to END_REASONS — a whole series cannot be cancelled for 'our side', and no test of the status route would notice

edits.to: export const otherSeriesCancelAll = z.object({ reasonCode: z.enum(END_REASONS),
